pool_schema.source: rest (pipeline label required by configs/rest_r1.json data.train; origin datasets kept in by_dataset/audit)

design_deviation.rule: raw_bbox = predicted_box * [width, height] as float pixel coordinates
design_deviation.reason: ReST pool rows are model predictions, not GT. The frozen contract requires answer == raw_bbox / (width, height); copying the GT raw_bbox would conflict with the supervised prediction and leak GT into the pool.

note: Pool rebuilt offline from a sampling audit; no GPU used. Records are the model's own predictions (normalised box) that passed the tau filter. Trainer-ready eight-field rows.

superseded.sampler_pool_note: old 4-field sampler pool (id/image/question/answer); superseded by the 8-field rebuild, kept as audit trail
superseded.seven_field_pool_note: intermediate 7-field rebuild rejected by src/eval/dataset.py REQUIRED_KEYS (missing raw_bbox); renamed, not deleted
superseded.reason: 4-field sampler pool and 7-field rebuild are both superseded by the current 8-field pool; old files kept as audit trail and must not be cited as the formal pool
